title: Everyday Phrases — Garage Sale
scene_zh: 庭院甩賣 · 情境對話
title_quote: Let's carry the boxes out one by one.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏷️ 實用庭院甩賣必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Garage Sale
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用庭院甩賣情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從擺桌分類、貼價簽掛指示牌開賣，到顧客淘衣物玩具傢俱、問價砍價，再到打包找零、搬大件送貨上門，最後收攤清剩貨、慈善捐贈與鄰裡聊天，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Garage Sale phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering setting up tables and price tags, browsing clothes, toys and furniture while haggling, packing, change and delivering big items, and closing up with donations and neighbor chats. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's carry the boxes out one by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈkæri ðə ˈbɑksəz ˈaʊt wʌn baɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們把紙箱一箱一箱搬出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll start with the light ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪl stɑrt wɪð ðə laɪt wʌnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we put the old couch?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi pʊt ði oʊld kaʊtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 那張舊沙發要擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right there, near the edge of the yard.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðɛr, nɪr ði ɛdʒ əv ðə jɑrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table won't fold flat again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the legs before you push it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə lɛɡz bɪˈfɔr ju pʊʃ ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 先把桌腳抬高再壓下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you grab another table from the garage?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ɡræb ˈʌnəðər ˈteɪbəl frʌm ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 你能再從車庫搬一張桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, and I'll bring two chairs too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ənd aɪl brɪŋ tu tʃɛrz tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a seat for the money box.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə sit fər ðə ˈmʌni bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 收銀箱旁邊得放個座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sit there and watch the cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɪt ðɛr ənd wɑtʃ ðə kæʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have enough small bills?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fives and ones from the bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, faɪvz ənd wʌnz frʌm ðə bæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 夠了，從銀行換的五塊和一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the coins in this little cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə kɔɪnz ɪn ðɪs ˈlɪtəl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 硬幣放在這個小杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, change gets lost so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, tʃeɪndʒ ɡɛts lɔst soʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，零錢很容易不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sort these books into small piles.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɔrt ðiz bʊks ˈɪntə smɔl paɪlz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll make one pile for children's stories.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl meɪk wʌn paɪl fər ˈtʃɪldrənz ˈstɔriz./
dialogue.zh: 我來分一堆兒童故事書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for these old magazines?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty cents each, nobody wants them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Group the kitchen things on this table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡruːp ðə ˈkɪtʃən θɪŋz ɑn ðɪs ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 廚房用品集中擺這張桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blender goes with the pans, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈblɛndər ɡoʊz wɪð ðə pænz, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 果汁機跟鍋子放一起，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please test the blender before selling it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz tɛst ðə ˈblɛndər bɪˈfɔr ˈsɛlɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 賣之前請先試一下果汁機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plug works, but the lid is loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plʌɡ wɜrks, bʌt ðə lɪd ɪz lus./
dialogue.zh: 插頭能用，但蓋子鬆鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write a note about the loose lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ə noʊt əˈbaʊt ðə lus lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 給鬆脫的蓋子寫張說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, buyers should know about it.
dialogue.zh: 也對，買家應該知道小毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wash these teddy bears first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi wɑʃ ðiz ˈtɛdi bɛrz fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No time, just brush off the dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ taɪm, dʒʌst brʌʃ ɔf ðə dʌst./
dialogue.zh: 來不及了，刷掉灰塵就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken toys go in this trash bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbroʊkən tɔɪz ɡoʊ ɪn ðɪs træʃ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 壞掉的玩具丟進這個垃圾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found a robot with no arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ə ˈroʊˌbɑt wɪð noʊ ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 我還找到一隻沒手的機器人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many boxes of clothes do we have?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑksəz ɑv kloʊz du wi hæv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four big ones, mostly winter coats.
dialogue.zh: 四大箱，多半是冬天外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the shirts on this clothing rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðə ʃɜrts ɑn ðɪs ˈkloʊðɪŋ ræk./
dialogue.zh: 上衣掛到這個衣架上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fold the pants on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl foʊld ðə pænts ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these shoes still have their laces?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ʃuz stɪl hæv ðɛr ˈleɪsəz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I tied each pair together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to write the price tags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the round orange stickers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What price for this wooden rocking chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt praɪs fər ðɪs ˈwʊdən ˈrɑkɪŋ tʃɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen dollars, it's old but strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything must go cheaper than the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ məst ɡoʊ ˈtʃipər ðən ðə stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 所有東西都要比商店便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So half price on most things?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start at one dollar for the dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt æt wʌn ˈdɑlər fər ðə ˈdɪʃəz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the big pots at three?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put three dots on the small toys.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt θri dɑts ɑn ðə smɔl tɔɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dot means a quarter, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write the number in big clear letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈnʌmbər ɪn bɪɡ klɪr ˈlɛtərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My handwriting looks like a kid's.
dialogue.zh: 我的字醜得像小孩寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stickers leave marks on the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪkərz liv marks ɑn ðə ɡlæs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll write on small paper tags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl raɪt ɑn smɔl ˈpeɪpər tæɡz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's put signs at the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Arrows help cars find our yard.
dialogue.zh: 箭頭能讓車子找到我們家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write big garage sale on the poster.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt bɪɡ ɡəˈrɑʒ seɪl ɑn ðə ˈpoʊstər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the date in red marker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape it firmly, the wind is strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪt ˈfɜrmli, ðə wɪnd ɪz strɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll weigh it down with a rock.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl weɪ ɪt daʊn wɪð ə rɑk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nail the banner to the fence post.
dialogue.phonetic: /nel ðə ˈbænər tu ðə fɛns poʊst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, don't hit your thumb again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sale starting at eight sharp?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə seɪl ˈstɑrtɪŋ æt eɪt ʃɑrp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the flyer says eight to two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈflaɪər sɛz eɪt tə tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I printed flyers for the whole block.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈprɪntɪd ˈflaɪərz fər ðə hoʊl blɑk./
dialogue.zh: 我為整條街都印了傳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, dog walkers see every sign.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，遛狗的人也看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our neighbor Nora came by already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She brought coffee for the helpers.
dialogue.zh: 她帶咖啡來給幫忙的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These extra tables came from Nora.
dialogue.zh: 這些多出來的桌子是娜拉借的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's save her a nice lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts seɪv ˈhɜr ə naɪs læmp./
dialogue.zh: 那我們先給她留一盞好看的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you watch the tables for a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wɑtʃ ðə ˈteɪbərz fər ə ˈmɪnət?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, go finish your morning coffee.
dialogue.zh: 好，去喝完你的早餐咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is perfect for a sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ə seɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But some shade would help the food.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt sʌm ʃeɪd wʊd hɛlp ðə fud./
dialogue.zh: 但有點陰涼才好放食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the lemonade under the umbrella.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free cups beside it, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a car is already stopping.
dialogue.zh: 你看，已經有車停下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's early, but let them browse.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, are you open yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost ready, come take a look.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome to our little garage sale.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨我們的車庫甩賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have the best yard on the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ðə bɛst jɑrd ɑn ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 你家的院子是街上最漂亮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please pick things up and look.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm looking for a record player.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, there's one on the back table.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛrz wʌn ɑn ðə bæk ˈteɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it still work?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It works, I tested it this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks, aɪ ˈtɛstəd ɪt ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this might be my first buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs maɪt bi maɪ fɜrst baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那這可能就是我今天第一筆收獲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's yours for eight dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I pay with dollar bills?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, cash is welcome here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's ten dollars, keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, that's very kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I packed it in a big box.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pækt ɪt ɪn ə bɪɡ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我用大紙箱把它包好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The record player already found a home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɛkərd ˈpleɪər ɔlˈrɛdi faʊnd ə hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More cars are slowing down already.
dialogue.zh: 更多車子開始減速靠邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The signs on the corner work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll refill the coffee pot inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring more cups and some napkins.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A line is forming by the toys.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪn ɪz ˈfɔrmɪŋ baɪ ðə tɔɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids always crowd the toy table.
dialogue.zh: 小孩總是擠在玩具桌旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't run around the tables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'll hold his hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's going better than we planned.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll finish by noon at this rate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ˈfɪnɪʃ baɪ nun æt ðɪs reɪt./
dialogue.zh: 照這速度中午就賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's take a quick break first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try these jeans on?
dialogue.zh: 我能試穿這條牛仔褲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, no mirrors here though.
dialogue.zh: 請便，不過這裡沒有鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll just hold them up instead.
dialogue.zh: 那我拿起來比一比好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That blue looks great on you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the denim jacket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars, it's barely worn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you take four?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four and a half, fair?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll take the jacket too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I'll bag it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get all three shirts together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɔl θri ʃɜrz təˈɡɛðər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bundle them for eight dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a real bargain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only want the closet empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these baby clothes clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, washed and folded neatly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My niece would love the pink ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nis wʊd lʌv ðə pɪŋk wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 我姪女一定喜歡粉紅色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're just a dollar for all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sizes are these winter boots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A seven and a nine, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsɛvən ənd ə naɪn, a θɪŋk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try the nine on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a mat by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They fit me really well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, they'll last many winters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much are the boots, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six, or five with the scarf.
dialogue.zh: 六塊，圍巾一起拿就五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the scarf deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, winter comes fast.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，冬天一下子就來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at this old toy truck!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My kid played with it daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the little key included?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's taped underneath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would two dollars be okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs fine, take two fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, he'll love it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids never tire of trucks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wooden chair feels a bit wobbly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwʊdən tʃɪr filz ə bɪt ˈwɑbli./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a good push test.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the legs are solid now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tightened them yesterday myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the whole bookshelf?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, it holds a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen would help me decide.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it sixteen and it's yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! I'll drive my truck over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, we're here all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm, wɪr hɪr ɔl deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lamp the last one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Nora already grabbed two.
dialogue.zh: 對，娜拉已經搶走兩盞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She moves fast at sales.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone knows Nora loves lamps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have old vinyl records?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One box, mostly jazz and blues.
dialogue.zh: 有一箱，大多是爵士和藍調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one looks almost new.
dialogue.zh: 這張看起來幾乎是新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's three, the rest are cheap.
dialogue.zh: 那張三塊，其他的更便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take three for two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, dig through the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this mirror so cheap?
dialogue.zh: 這面鏡子為什麼這麼便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a crack near the edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, that doesn't bother me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take it for two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who made this pretty quilt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My grandmother sewed it years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it still keep you warm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the cotton inside is thick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for such a treasure?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name a fair price yourself.
dialogue.zh: 你自己開個公道的價吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty, if that's not too much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's more than fair, it's yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the baby stroller still for sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈbeɪbi ˈstroʊlər stɪl fər seɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten dollars, wheels are new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it fold up small?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it folds with one click.
dialogue.zh: 你看，一個卡扣就收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's really clever and handy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try pushing it around the yard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The handle feels a bit loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can tie it with some string.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən taɪ ɪt wɪð sʌm strɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would eight dollars work for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, and I'll add the rain cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn, ənd aɪl æd ðə reɪn ˈkʌvər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I'll pay nine dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll hold it by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪl hoʊld ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell clothes hangers too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the whole armful, free.
dialogue.zh: 你抱的那整把免費拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That saves me a store trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪəli? ðæt seɪvz mi ə stɔr trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我省得跑一趟商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We own far too many hangers.
dialogue.zh: 我們家衣架實在太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these dishes chipped anywhere?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check each rim before you buy.
dialogue.zh: 買之前每個邊緣都看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This plate has a tiny crack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it out of the stack.
dialogue.zh: 把它從那一疊裡拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six plates for two dollars?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus one for the cups.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm collecting old picture frames.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a pile near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some are missing their glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wood ones are still lovely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll repaint them for new photos.
dialogue.zh: 我要重新上色放新照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a fun plan.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是個有趣的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please save these for ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 幫我留這些十分鐘好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I'll set them aside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been shopping forever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, yet it flew by.
dialogue.zh: 才一小時，但一下就過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I pack all this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have boxes under the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the plates in newspaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fold each sheet twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take this roll of clear tape.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll seal the box shut.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, that box is heavy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll carry it slow and steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have change for twenty?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check my money box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm low on tens already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the corner store can help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll run over and be quick.
dialogue.zh: 我跑去換一下，馬上回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wait right here, no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, the crowd slowed down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, twenty minus fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, here's your five back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count it with me, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, five. Perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your total is eighteen fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lamp plus books, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus two for the boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, boxes aren't free at stores.
dialogue.zh: 應該的，商店的箱子也不免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who's taking the big bookshelf?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me, my car is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to lift this with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, lift when I say three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, three, up we go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mind the hose on the ground.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nearly at the car now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it down on the grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your trunk open wide?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tilt it in from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɪlt ɪt ɪn frʌm ðə tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like that, it fits exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now nothing rattles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who bought the green couch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The young couple by the fence.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their van is huge, luckily.
dialogue.zh: 幸虧他們的廂型車很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll load it in minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's slide this blanket under it.
dialogue.zh: 把這條毯子墊在沙發下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no scratches on the seats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the door, it's coming in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it sideways, slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stairway is tighter than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈstɛrˌweɪ ɪz ˈtaɪtər ðən aɪ θɔt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, let's tilt it down first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch your step on the last one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ jʊr stɛp ɑn ðə læst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're through, it fits upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly do you want it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Against the wall by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one more little push.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, it looks great there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we level the legs too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a coin under one works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You live just two streets away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can walk back easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me help you carry those bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi hɛlp ju ˈkæri ðoʊz bæɡz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're kind, but my husband is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr kaɪnd, bʌt maɪ ˈhʌzbənd ɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你真好，不過我先生來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, did I miss the sale?
dialogue.zh: 早，我是不是錯過甩賣了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we're just packing up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sell the coffee maker?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an hour ago, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 賣了，一小時前，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about that blue lamp?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one's still for sale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take it, here's five dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll wrap the shade.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No need, I'll hold it tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then drive safe on the way home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn draɪv seɪf ɑn ðə weɪ hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anyone ask about the bike?
dialogue.zh: 有人問過那輛腳踏車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people, but no deal yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seat is rusty, remember?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wrote it on the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, a roʊt ɪt ɑn ðə tæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That man is coming back now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he brought exact cash.
dialogue.zh: 說不定他帶了剛好現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back for the bike, I hope?
dialogue.zh: 是回來要那輛腳踏車的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, is it still thirty dollars?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty, and the bell is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈθɜrti, ənd ðə bɛl ɪz fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got yourself a deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you ride it to your car?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju raɪd ɪt tə jʊr kɑr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, brakes work fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the bike inside carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits, doors close easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still need more boxes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, these two are enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tie the string around twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it's safe to carry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take the extra bags too.
dialogue.zh: 給，多出來的袋子也拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always think of everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moving that couch took real muscle.
dialogue.zh: 搬那張沙發真的費了好大力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My back still remembers those stairs.
dialogue.zh: 我的背還記得那些樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, it looks great in that room.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, ɪt lʊks ɡreɪt ɪn ðæt rum./
dialogue.zh: 不過擺在他們客廳真好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they'll sleep on it tonight.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，他們今晚就有得躺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sweep the garage now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, one table is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That picnic table needs a buyer.
dialogue.zh: 那張野餐桌還在等買家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sleep on it, okay?
dialogue.zh: 讓我睡一覺再決定，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By tomorrow morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll call after breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it's saved just for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, talk to you soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock says two, let's close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll start folding tables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last customer just drove off.
dialogue.zh: 最後一位顧客剛開車離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she take the yellow chair?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and the box of dishes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sold more than I hoped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Help me stack the leftover cups.
dialogue.zh: 幫我把剩的杯子疊起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a few pieces left now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweep the yard before dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll get the broom from inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins everywhere under the tables.
dialogue.zh: 桌子底下到處都是硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found three by my shoe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you count the money yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, pass me the calculator.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, my phone works too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred twenty in cash!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that's a good day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still short of our two hundred goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ʃɔrt ʌv ˈaʊər tu ˈhʌndrəd ɡoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 離兩百塊的目標還差一截。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better than any yard sale plan.
dialogue.zh: 比原先的計畫好太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, what about the leftovers?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clothes didn't move much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelter takes clean clothes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? How do we send them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They pick up boxes by request.
dialogue.zh: 預約後他們會上門收紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll call today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask about the books too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The school library needs more books.
dialogue.zh: 學校圖書館需要更多書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the kids' stories go there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape the box shut and write school.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ðə bɑks ʃʌt ənd raɪt skul./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, one less thing tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the chipped plates?
dialogue.zh: 那些缺角的盤子怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old tiles, maybe a craft group.
dialogue.zh: 舊磁磚嘛，也許手作社團要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask Maria, she paints pottery.
dialogue.zh: 我問問瑪莉亞，她彩繪陶器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll love free materials.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The broken toys still smell dusty.
dialogue.zh: 壞玩具聞起來還是灰灰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pile goes to the trash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sad, but some things truly end.
dialogue.zh: 可惜，但有些東西真該結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp with no shade stays?
dialogue.zh: 那盞沒燈罩的燈留下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can fix it next weekend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than sending it away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nora's still browsing our last table.
dialogue.zh: 娜拉還在翻我們最後那張桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wants the garden tools.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do we ask her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neighbors get the neighbor price.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five dollars between friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll say yes right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey Nora, the tools are five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap at half the store price.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you got the extra rake.
dialogue.zh: 多出來那把耙子也算你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll water your plants Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, we leave Saturday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your tomatoes live too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids left chalk art everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's leave it, it looks cheerful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, rain will erase it soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you see the lemonade money?
dialogue.zh: 你看到檸檬汁的錢了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty in tips, folks were generous.
dialogue.zh: 小費就有三十，大家真大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll donate that to the food bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈdoʊnˌeɪt ðæt tə ðə fud bæŋk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, they need it before winter.
dialogue.zh: 應該的，冬天前他們很缺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can pack cans from the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən pæk kænz frʌm ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 架上那些罐頭也能打包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the soup we never eat.
dialogue.zh: 對，還有我們從來不喝的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the rice, two big bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They take anything canned or dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll drive over before five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take my van, it's empty now.
dialogue.zh: 開我的廂型車，現在是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The couch spot is empty too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We left it right by their window.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛft ɪt raɪt baɪ ðɛr ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們把它擺在他們的窗邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stood there waving goodbye.
dialogue.zh: 他們站在那裡跟我們揮手道別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They seemed so happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First apartment for both of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the cheap price was worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə tʃip praɪs wʌz wɜrð ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以賣那麼便宜也值得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our garage looks enormous now.
dialogue.zh: 咱車庫現在看起來好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty walls feel strange somehow.
dialogue.zh: 空蕩蕩的牆有種陌生的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've planned this cleanout for years.
dialogue.zh: 這場清空計畫我們拖好幾年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today we finally did.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And earned some money too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's treat ourselves tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們犒賞一下自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pizza and a movie?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You read my mind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll order the big one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one last thing outside.
dialogue.zh: 等等，外面還有最後一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signs! We must take them down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪnz! wi məst teɪk ðɛm daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pull the nails carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold the posters for next year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next year? We promised never again.
dialogue.zh: 明年？我們發誓不再辦了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say that after a good sleep.
dialogue.zh: 睡一覺你就不這麼說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, you're probably right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner sign is coming down?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the wind took half already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the arrows, they're useful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, boxes need arrows.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the donation run tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our street feels friendly today.
dialogue.zh: 今天整條街都暖呼呼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neighbors stopped and chatted all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was half the fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mrs. Lee even brought her pie.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should thank the whole block.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with Nora, she helped most.
dialogue.zh: 先謝娜拉，她幫的忙最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, until the next sale.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, dream of bargains.
